about_the_game:
Master movement in a vehicular hero shooter where agility is your ultimate weapon. In a future devastated by an AI rebellion, humanity depends on elite pilots to take control of the HoverTanks: advanced war machines that combine speed with agility never before seen in a vehicle, and with devastating firepower.

Inspired by the high-skill duels of classics like Unreal Tournament, GunZ: The Duel, and the team-based strategy of modern hero shooters, Hoverise Rebellion offers a combat experience where mastery of movement sets you apart from the rest.

MASTERY THROUGH MOVEMENT

Forget ground combat. In Hoverise Rebellion, the battlefield is three-dimensional. It's easy to learn but hard to master.

  • Core Movement: Jump, dodge, and slide across the map with an intuitive and fluid control system.

  • Unique Skill Layer per Class: Each HoverTank has unique movement abilities that, once mastered, will allow you to execute aerial combos, high-speed feints, and impossible flanks. Movement isn't just for getting around, it's your primary offensive and defensive tool.

CHOOSE YOUR HERO, DEFINE YOUR COMBAT STYLE

Each HoverTank is piloted by a unique hero, creating distinct characters and tactical roles. Whether you prefer to lead the assault, protect your allies, or control the battlefield from a distance, there's a hero for you. Choose your class and weapon combination, and discover devastating synergies. 

The launch roster will include:

  • Duelist: An aggressive duelist designed to break enemy lines with speed and an assault rifle.

  • Tank: The team's anchor. A heavily armored defender who controls space with an energy shield and a close-range shotgun.

  • Tactical: Change the tide of battle with drones and combat intelligence, using available tools to outsmart the enemy.

TACTICAL TEAM COMBAT

Coordination is key to victory. Hoverise Rebellion is designed from the ground up for competitive team play. Fight in a variety of classic game modes and in our flagship mode, "Assault," where one team must destroy a series of objectives while the other defends with everything they've got. Communicate with your team, combine your abilities, and execute coordinated strategies to claim victory.

KEY FEATURES

  • High-Speed Vehicular Combat: Experience unparalleled freedom of movement in a third-person shooter.

  • Different HoverTanks, Different Styles: Master unique classes with distinct movement and combat abilities.

  • Competitive Game Modes: From classic Team Deathmatch to the tactical objective-based mode "Assault".

  • Customization: Unlock cosmetic items for your pilot and your HoverTank to fight in style.

The rebellion has begun. Do you have the skill to stop it? Add Hoverise Rebellion to your wishlist and join the fight!
